name: API Tester
description: HTTP and gRPC API testing workbench for DBX.
releaseNotes: gRPC services can be called from imported .proto files without server reflection, including client and bidirectional streaming. In-flight requests can be cancelled, default timeouts are configurable, and the history sidebar can be collapsed or resized.

zh-CN.description: 在 DBX 工作台里调试 HTTP 接口、调用 gRPC 服务。
